Description:
snowypines' reworked starry sky interface (original by walpi), but compatible with 1.6

Thank you BeneathThePlass for making it Content Patcher compatible!
Thank you snowypines for your rework!

Downloads.Description: If you have the Generic Mod Config Menu mod, just extract this file, and copy/paste the "assets" folder into your GMCM mod to replace the "assets" folder in there
If you have the Convenient Inventory mod, extract this file, then copy/paste the "quickStackIcon.png" file into the "assets" folder of the Convenient Inventory mod.
If you have the Stardew And Chill mod, extract the "button.png" file into the Stardew And Chill mod folder to replace the file there.
